items.title: Announcing the developer preview of Transfer Manager for Amazon S3 in the AWS SDK for JavaScript v3
items.summary: On October 15, 2026, we launched the developer preview of Transfer Manager (@aws-sdk/lib-transfer-manager). It gives JavaScript developers a simpler way to move large datasets to and from Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) at high throughput. Transfer Manager provides a set of high-level operations for high-throughput uploads and downloads. It coordinates multipart requests, concurrency, checksums, and […]
